title: the inference proxy's rename recipe reaches 5432 only through db_domain
intention: the inference proxy reaches Postgres only through db_domain's store, its rename recipe included.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i at origin/main c3d8c3593: tools/import_sieve's test_sole_path_is_clean_on_the_real_corpus_for_both_domains reds on 'cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/rename_instance.py imports [psycopg2, psycopg2.sql] — a SECOND door to 5432'. The import came in with 60e1dd170 under ticket f942a413f26d (whose state still reads TICKETME:waiting): apply_tables composes its DDL with psycopg2.sql, around db_domain's store. The orchestrator asked for the fix.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 4 (the 5432 sole path is physics, import_sieve).
how: D1: rename_instance.py drops 'from psycopg2 import sql'; a local _ident(name) double-quotes an identifier with any inner quote doubled (what sql.Identifier renders), and the fold, table rename and index rename compose their DDL with it on the store's connection. _fold_new_into_old loses its sql parameter. Owner-gated drop, update and delete stay the store's. D2: new proof cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/proofs/test_the_rename_recipe_goes_through_the_one_door.py: tooth 1 runs the 5432 sole-path rule over the real corpus and reads the recipe's imports with import_sieve.imports_in; tooth 2 drives apply_tables over a recording connection and a fake store and asserts the exact quoted DDL.

clauses.claim: the 5432 sole-path rule over the real corpus catches nothing under cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/, and the recipe's parsed imports hold no Postgres driver
apply_tables composes the fold, the table rename and the index rename with every identifier double-quoted and any inner quote doubled
